title: New e-bike regulations for kids
description:
The City of San Diego is launching a public education and outreach campaign on e-bike safety ahead of new regulations for kids. 

Recently approved e-bike regulations impose a minimum age of 12 years for Class One and Two e-bikes, essentially making a pedal bike the only bike approved for kids under 12: insidesandiego.org/new-e-bike-regulations-take-effect-san-diego
